description: This file defines the internal interface ISiloControl for Orleans, outlining control operations related to silos such as gathering statistics, garbage collection, and activation management.

classes.name: ISiloControl
classes.description: An internal interface in Orleans for managing and controlling silo operations such as statistics collection, garbage collection, and activation management.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping message to check the liveness of the silo.

methods.name: ForceGarbageCollection
methods.description: Triggers garbage collection on the silo.

methods.name: ForceActivationCollection
methods.description: Forces activation collection for grains older than the specified age limit.

methods.name: ForceRuntimeStatisticsCollection
methods.description: Collects runtime statistics from the silo.

methods.name: GetRuntimeStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves runtime statistics for the silo.

methods.name: GetGrainStatistics
methods.description: Returns statistics for grains, including their IDs, types, and counts.

methods.name: GetDetailedGrainStatistics
methods.description: Provides detailed statistics for grains, optionally filtered by types.

methods.name: GetSimpleGrainStatistics
methods.description: Returns an array of simple grain statistics.

methods.name: GetDetailedGrainReport
methods.description: Gets a detailed report for a specific grain identified by its GrainId.

methods.name: GetActivationCount
methods.description: Returns the current count of active grain activations.

methods.name: MigrateRandomActivations
methods.description: Migrates a specified number of grain activations to a target silo.

methods.name: SendControlCommandToProvider
methods.description: Sends a control command to a specified provider.

methods.name: GetActiveGrains
methods.description: Retrieves a list of active grains for a given grain type.
